criteria_notes.note: caddytest/integration/stream_test.go::TestH2ExtendedConnectWebSocket (runs in a child process with GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1); caddytest/integration/stream_reload_test.go::TestStreamDetachedReload covers the HTTP/1.1 upgrade in detached mode.

modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/metrics_test.go::TestStreamStatsMetrics (active gauge, closed-by-result counter, duration histogram, bytes to and from backend; first result wins; double finish counts once); ::TestStreamStatsDefaultResult; ::TestInitReverseProxyMetricsRegistersStreamMetrics; ::TestInitReverseProxyMetricsConflict. modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/detached_test.go::TestStreamAccountedOnce (cleanup result, both directions ending, repeated finish: counted once); ::TestStreamTimeout (timeout result); ::TestAttachedStreamClosedOnCleanup (cleanup result, active gauge back to 0); ::TestDetachedStreamSurvivesReload (upstream_removed result). modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/streaming_test.go::TestSwitchProtocolCopierCountsBytes and ::TestCloseConnectionsCallsOnClose.
Doc comments on Handler.StreamDetached, Handler.StreamLogs and the StreamLogs fields in reverseproxy.go and detached.go, plus the Caddyfile syntax block and explanatory paragraph in caddyfile.go.

Registry: detached_test.go::TestDetachedRegistry. Config parsing: caddyfile_test.go. Metrics: metrics_test.go. Recorder hijack: responsewriter_test.go. Encode post-hijack: encode_test.go::TestResponseWriterHijackStopsWrites and ::TestResponseWriterHijackNotSupported. Intercept post-hijack: only covered by the integration test TestInterceptUpgrade, since there is no intercept unit test file in scope.
